## Update 1.3.5 Beta 3

**New Features:**
* Sources open instantly, even offline, using the last copy Feather saved, then refresh in the background
* The update prompt is a sheet with readable release notes instead of a cramped alert

**Bug Fixes:**
* Leftover files from signing and installing are cleared automatically after a day, freeing storage
* Icons next to text grow with your iPhone's text size setting
